about_the_game:
Train Plus | DLC: "Platform 3 Wrapping" Train

Enhance your Train Plus experience by adding the exclusive "Platform 3 Wrapping" train from Kōwa Dentetsu!

Please Note:
This is downloadable content. The base game, Train Plus, is required to play.

About the "Platform 3 Wrapping" Train

Experience a fresh twist on the iconic Kōwa Dentetsu 4050 series! Developed as a dedicated train for the Nanokasen on the Kōwa Dentetsu main line, the "Platform 3 Wrapping" train primarily operates on the route from Gekkō Station to Kinsai-bashi Station and onward to Hiyori Station.

Download now and redefine your rail adventures!
